title: Legit got full body chills during this- Immersive Phantom (@Masquerad...
transcript: Y'all, immersive Phantom just did another surprise drop, and guess what? This time I got to do the immersive experience. This all started with yet another post to the Masquerade NYC Instagram account, which had an address, a time, and a passcode, as well as a picture of an ice cream truck. Now, I assume they were just gonna be giving out some free ice cream, but I should have known better, because in hindsight, it is never that simple when it comes to these immersive phantom drops, because while they were giving out free ice cream, some people also got an envelope. And much like the envelopes in the last drop, it had an address on it, which LED you to a psychic shop. Now, I actually did not get one of these envelopes, but I had heard of rumblings of something to do with tarot cards. So when I saw this psychic shop a little bit down the street from the ice cream truck, I decided to go investigate. It has a red sign outside that says Madame Zephrine. And as I'm kind of scoping it out, I see a guy run out of the psychic shop holding something in his hands. I later found out that that guy is part of this whole interactive universe that they are building. But I don't really have time to get into that because I want to tell you what happened when I went in the shop, because after that guy, Runs away. I turn around and I see this woman in the doorway, dressed in red, who says, can I help you? Come to find out that. That is Madame Zephyrine. And she brings me into her little studio. I have a seat at her table and there is a little cassette player playing some operatic music. And she does a tarot reading for me. She does my past card, she does my present card. And as she is doing the present card, the cassette player that she has playing music just stops. I honestly just thought the tape had run out. I didn't really think anything of it at the time. But then she does my future card, and when she pulls it, she looks frightened. She hands the card to me and says, what does this say? And as she does that, the cassette player starts playing masquerade. And I see that the card is the red death card with the message, did you think I had left you for good? She looks at me and says, this is a message for you. He wants you to know that he hasn't left. I don't know how that card got there, but I don't want it in my deck, so you should take it. And so I take the card, I leave the shop, and that's it. I'm once again just blown away at the level of detail that they are putting into these marketing stunts. And I actually Believe that they are all connected. It's all. Probably make a separate video on that. So I don't know if these are going to be characters in the immersive Phantom experience or if this is just elaborate world building for their marketing. But either way, I am invested, and I am just on the edge of my seat to find out what happens next.
